question: Parallax error is an example of which type of error?
solution:
The correct answer is __Systematic error**(option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Parallax error__ is a common example of a systematic error.
 
• It occurs due to incorrect observation of the position of an object.
 
• This error arises when the observer’s eye is not placed perpendicular to the scale or measuring device.
 
• Parallax error is predictable and repeatable, which makes it systematic in nature.
 
• Such errors can be minimized by ensuring proper alignment and observation techniques.
 
• It is different from random errors, which are unpredictable and irregular.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Random error:**
 
 
• These errors are unpredictable and occur due to unknown factors or variations in the measurement process.
 
• They can be minimized by taking multiple measurements and averaging.
 
 
 
• **Gross error:**
 
 
• Gross errors are caused by mistakes such as wrong readings, incorrect instrument setup, or human error.
 
• They can often be avoided through careful handling and proper training.
 
 
 
• **Instrumental error:**
 
 
• These errors occur due to imperfections in the measuring instrument itself.
 
• They can be reduced by calibrating the instrument regularly.
